The Share a Link and Discussion button, how do I go about changing the text of them, the color, as well as remove the link button? I'd like them to to say something like Giveaway instead of Discuss, and Link Giveaway instead of share a link, and to have them match the subverse theme.

I can't figure out how to correctly change the buttons in the header ATM, but here's my partial solution, which is just the sidebar buttons:

.side .submit-link,
.side .submit-text {
 font-size: 0;
 border: none;
 line-height: 2;
 background: #202430;
 color: #34B9FF;
}

.side .submit-link:hover,
.side .submit-text:hover {
 background: #303647;
 color: #E1E1E1;
}

.side .submit-link::after,
.side .submit-text::after {
 font-size: 12px;
}

.side .submit-link::after {
 content: "LINK GIVEAWAY";
}

.side .submit-text::after {
 content: "GIVEAWAY";
}

If you want to remove an element entirely, use display: none;, as in:

.side .submit-link {
 display: none;
}

/u/miro's got it spot on, however if a user is using a modification that adds more buttons to the side bar, they show up with the stock style. For example

Currently you have it set to find the specific buttons and chage them idividually. If you use the following;

.side .btn-block {
 border: none;
 line-height: 2;
 background: #202430;
 color: #34B9FF;
}

.side .btn-block:hover {
 background: #303647;
 color: #E1E1E1;
}

.side .submit-link,
.side .submit-text {
 font-size: 0;
} 

.side .submit-link::after {
 content: " LINK GIVEAWAY ";
 font-size: 12px;
}

.side .submit-text::after {
 content: " GIVEAWAY ";
 font-size: 12px;
}

It will change it for all buttons (btn-block) in the .side class (the side bar), even if they're not originaly on VOAT. There's probably a better way of doing the above, but that works out for me with no issues. If anything crazy happens using the above code, revert back to /u/miro's :)

**Daily Devotional**

**April 4**

*16 For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him: (Colossians 1:16 KJV)*

This verse removes all doubt that Jesus was God in the flesh. Jesus was the creator of all things physical and spiritual. Notice that all things were not only created by Him, but for Him. That means that we, being part of His creation, are created for Him and for His pleasure (Revelation 4:11). Jesus is above all things, being the Creator, and all things including us humans as well as Angels are commanded to worship Him (Hebrews 1:6). Even the spirits that are now evil must have been created by Jesus, and then became corrupted. This just shows again how Jesus and the Father are one (John 10:30).

The fact that Jesus is the Creator, and is God’s Son (Luke 1:32), leaves no room for the religious groups who claim that Jesus was not God, but only an Angel. If it were true that Jesus was a created being, then when Angels are commanded to worship Jesus (Hebrews 1:6). it would be creature worship and go against the verses in Nehemiah 9:6 that say that Angels worship Jehovah. There is just no getting around the fact that Jesus and God are one, as the Bible says (John 17:22), and all Christians must believe in the divinity of Christ, as it is well documented in scripture, and important to the Christian faith. Thank you Lord for coming and bringing us back into close fellowship with you (John 17:3).

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
